fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects usage of Time Travel Debugging Utility. Adversaries can execute malicious processes and dump processes, such as lsass.exe, via tttracer.exe.
fields.name: Time Travel Debugging Utility Usage - Image
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\\ttdrecord.dll" or module.path contains "\\ttdwriter.dll" or module.path contains "\\ttdloader.dll"))
